name: Greece
summary: Drug use and possession for own use are criminal offences (Law 4139/2013, art. 29: up to 5 months' prison, can go unpunished if one-off; dependent users can be diverted to treatment). Medical cannabis legal.
callingForHelp: No specific Good Samaritan law found. Use and possession remain criminal, so police involvement is possible; health staff are bound by medical confidentiality.
drugChecking: No established public drug-checking service found.

lsd.note: Use and possession for own use are crimes: up to 5 months' prison, often suspended; may go unpunished if one-off and kept off criminal record copies.

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin/psilocin are controlled and mushrooms are treated as psilocin: possession for own use is a crime (up to 5 months' prison).

dmt.note: DMT is UN Schedule I: possession for own use is a crime (up to 5 months' prison, often suspended).

mescaline.note: Mescaline is UN Schedule I: possession for own use is a crime (up to 5 months' prison). Status of cacti not confirmed.

dox.note: DOM, DOB, DOC are UN Schedule I: possession for own use is a crime (up to 5 months' prison, often suspended).

nbomes.note: NBOMes are UN Schedule I: possession for own use is a crime (up to 5 months' prison, often suspended).

2c-x.note: 2C-B is UN Schedule II: possession for own use is a crime (up to 5 months' prison, often suspended).

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T-2/2C-T-7 are not UN-scheduled; could not confirm whether Greece lists them nationally.

5-meo-xxt.note: 5-MeO-DMT and 5-MeO-MiPT are not UN-scheduled; could not confirm whether Greece lists them nationally.

cannabis.note: Possession or growing for own use: up to 5 months' prison (may go unpunished if one-off). Medical cannabis legal since 2017.

ketamine.note: Prescription anaesthetic; could not confirm its national control status. If controlled, non-prescribed possession is a crime.

mxe.note: UN Schedule II since 2016: possession for own use is a crime (up to 5 months' prison).

dxm.note: Not a controlled drug; could not confirm its pharmacy/prescription status in Greece.

nitrous.note: Not UN-scheduled; no national ban or rule found in sources checked.

amphetamines.note: Possession for own use is a crime (up to 5 months' prison, often suspended). Methylphenidate is available on prescription for ADHD.

mdma.note: Use and possession for own use are crimes: up to 5 months' prison, often suspended; may go unpunished if one-off and kept off criminal record copies.

cocaine.note: Use and possession for own use are crimes: up to 5 months' prison, often suspended; may go unpunished if one-off and kept off criminal record copies.

caffeine.note: Not a controlled substance; sold freely.

alcohol.note: Legal for adults; selling alcohol to under-18s is prohibited.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is UN Schedule II: possession for own use is a crime. GBL/1,4-BD status not confirmed. Sodium oxybate is prescription-only.

opioids.note: Heroin: possession for own use is a crime (up to 5 months' prison); dependent users can be diverted to treatment. Prescription opioids medical-only.

benzodiazepines.note: Prescription-only (list D); possession without a prescription can be prosecuted as drug possession.

maois.note: MAOI antidepressants are prescription-only. Status of harmala alkaloids/ayahuasca not confirmed (DMT is controlled).
